shorts.title: Opossums Can't Help Playing Dead 💀
shorts.description:
Opossums play dead. They can't help it. Opossums are North America's only marsupial: the babies grow up in a pouch.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: This Moth Has a Skull on Its Back, and It Squeaks 💀
shorts.description:
This moth has a skull on its back. It squeaks by sucking air into its throat and pushing it back out, unlike most moths, which can't make a sound.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Death's-head hawkmoth: Robin Schmidt (CC BY), CC0, e8iQXX (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0

shorts.title: Ghost Crabs Growl With Teeth in Their Stomach 👻
shorts.description:
Ghost crabs growl with teeth in their stomach. Ghost crabs can also make sounds by rubbing their claws, so they have two ways to warn you off.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: This Bird Fakes a Broken Wing to Trick You 🐦
shorts.description:
This bird fakes a broken wing. Killdeer are named for their call, a loud 'kill-deer'.
